contexts.text: Nineveh was forgiven, because of this their character.
If, perchance, good Spirits speak or do what is evil, they are not punished, but are forgiven, and are also excused, because their end is not to speak or do what is evil...
In like manner, they who believe that sins can be forgiven by men (do the evil of falsity).
From (the things of love and faith) come the forgiveness of sins, that is, the removals from them, because sins are removed by love and faith from the Lord.

The forgiveness of sins, expiation, propitiation, and redemption are nothing else than purification from evils and falsities, the implantation of good and truth, and their conjunction; thus regeneration. References.
They think that sins are not sins before God, because they have been pardoned.
A criminal who... prays that the judge will pardon him...
(The hatred of those who will not forgive. Representation.)
